post_understanding.summary: MySQL slow query log is recording many fast queries with Query_time well below the long_query_time threshold. The configuration shows log-queries-not-using-indexes=ON, which causes queries that do not use indexes to be logged regardless of execution time.
symptoms: unexpectedly high volume of entries in slow log
Query_time values far below long_query_time threshold
suspected_root_causes: log_queries_not_using_indexes enabled causing logging regardless of time
min_examined_row_limit at default 0 so all non-indexed queries are logged
extended slow log verbosity enabled (Percona/MariaDB), increasing visibility of non-slow events
slow admin/slave statements options may add more noise (less likely the primary cause)
key_evidence: Slow log samples show Query_time around 0.0003–0.0023 seconds
Rows_examined values (e.g., 423, 1456, 1727) consistent with full scans or LIMIT 1 scans without indexes
assumptions: Assumption: The server is MySQL-compatible (MariaDB or Percona Server) supporting log_queries_not_using_indexes and log_slow_verbosity.
Assumption: min_examined_row_limit is at its default 0.
Assumption: The posted my.cnf values reflect active runtime variables for the test.
Assumption: Queries being logged are not using indexes (e.g., WHERE on non-indexed columns or LIMIT 1 scans).
Assumption: The slow log format includes Query_time lines similar to the post (Percona/MariaDB extended slow log).

anomaly_injection.name: enable_logging_of_non_indexed_queries
anomaly_injection.method: Apply runtime variables to mimic the provided configuration
safety_notes: Run on a non-production instance; enabling logging can grow files quickly.
Ensure slow log rotation and disk space limits are in place.

metrics.expected_change: increase due to logging of non-indexed queries regardless of duration
values vary (e.g., 300–1800) consistent with table scans or early-stop LIMIT scans

query_or_transaction_effects: Unindexed SELECTs appear in the slow log even when Query_time is far less than long_query_time.
Indexed SELECTs do not appear in the slow log unless they exceed long_query_time.
validation_criteria: With log_queries_not_using_indexes=ON and min_examined_row_limit=0, the slow log contains many entries where Query_time < 2 seconds.
Turning log_queries_not_using_indexes OFF (post-test) stops logging of these fast unindexed queries, confirming the cause.
Sample slow log lines include Query_time around milliseconds and Rows_examined in the hundreds to low thousands.
